intro: The mezze table of the Levant: dips, salads, grilled meats and flatbreads shared by everyone, bright with lemon, garlic and herbs.
flavours: Chickpeas, tahini, lemon, garlic, parsley, olive oil, sumac

dishes.name: Hummus
dishes.what: Smooth dip of chickpeas blended with tahini, lemon and garlic.

dishes.name: Falafel
dishes.what: Deep-fried balls of ground chickpeas or fava beans with herbs, tucked in pitta.

dishes.name: Shawarma
dishes.what: Spit-roasted marinated meat shaved into flatbread with garlic sauce and pickles.

dishes.name: Tabbouleh
dishes.what: Herb salad, mostly parsley, with bulgur, tomato, lemon and mint.

dishes.name: Fattoush
dishes.what: Crunchy salad with toasted pitta pieces and sour sumac dressing.

dishes.name: Baba ghanoush
dishes.what: Smoky dip of charred aubergine with tahini and lemon.

dishes.name: Kibbeh
dishes.what: Torpedo-shaped croquettes of bulgur and lamb, stuffed with spiced meat and pine nuts.

dishes.name: Manakish
dishes.what: Lebanese breakfast flatbread topped with za'atar and olive oil, or cheese.
